senses.gloss:
वय् वय्, cl. 1. A. वयते, वेये, वयितुम्, to
go; (for cl. 1. P. वयति, &c., see rt. वे.)

वय वय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. वे), one who
weaves, a weaver; (ई), f., Ved. a female weaver.

वया, f., Ved. strength, power, (according to Sāy.
on Ṛg-veda I. 165, 15. वयाम् = वयम्, we); a
branch, twig; a race, family, (according to Sāy. on
Ṛg-veda X. 124, 3. वयायाः = गन्तव्यायाः.)
—वया-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. = वयस्-वत्, pos-
sessed of power or vigour; (Sāy. on Ṛg-veda VI. 2,
5. वया = शाखा = पुत्र-पौत्रादि, having pos-
terity, peopled with descendants.)

वय्य वय्य, अस्, m., Ved., N. of an Asura
(a companion of Turvīti, both of whom Indra helped
over a stream which obstructed their course; but
according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda I. 54, 6. वय्यम् =
वय्य-कुल-जम्, Vayya being merely a patronymic
of Turvīti); a companion, friend (?) .

वाय वाय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. वे), weaving,
sewing.
—वाय-दण्ड, अस्, m. a weaver's loom.

वाय्य वाय्य, अस्, m., Ved. ‘son of Vayya,’
epithet of Satya-śravas (represented as a poet and an
Ātreya).
वयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, weaving, sewing.
वयन, अम्, n. the act of weaving, &c.

वायन वायन or वायनक, अम्, n. (said to
be fr. rt. 2. वा), sweetmeats or cakes which may be
eaten during a religious fast, presents of sweetmeats
&c. (forming part of an offering to a deity, or pre-
pared on festive occasions, such as marriages &c., and
sent as presents to friends and acquaintances).

वयियु, Ved. anything woven, cloth, clothes, (Ṛg-
veda VIII. 19, 37. according to Durga = वस्त्रादि.)

वयियु वयियु. See under वय, p. 886,
col. 3.
वयिष्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. about to weave.

वयिष्यत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, Ved. about to
weave, weaving.

वयम् वयम् (nom. pl. of अहम्, see अस्मद्,
p. 108), we.

वयस् वयस्, अस्, n. (in some senses fr. rt.
1. वी), food, victuals, sacrificial food, oblation, offering
(Ved.); energy (both bodily and mental), strength,
vigour, power, might (Ved.); soundness, health
(Ved.); the time of health and strength, youth, the
prime of life; any period of life, age, time of life,
stage of existence, year of life or age; any period,
step, degree, kind; a bird, any winged animal, the
winged tribe (especially applied to smaller birds, cf.
2. वि).
—वयः-परिणति, इस्, f. ripeness of age.
—वयः-प्रमाण, अम्, n. measure or length of
life, duration of life, age.
—वयः-सन्धि, इस्, m.
‘age-junction,’ puberty.
—वयः-सम, अस्, आ, अम्,
of the same age, equal in age.
—वयः-स्थ, अस्, आ,
अम्, being in the period of youth or in the prime of
life, young, youthful; grown up, mature, middle-
aged; strong, powerful; (अस्), m. a contemporary,
associate, friend; (आ), f. a female contemporary,
female friend or companion [cf. वयस्या]; N. of
several plants, Emblica Officinalis; the moon-plant,
Asclepias Acida; a medicinal root (= काकोली, क्षीर-
काकोली); Terminalia Chebula or Citrina; Cocculus
Cordifolius; Bombax Heptaphyllum; = अत्य्-अम्ल-
पर्णी; small cardamoms.
—वयः-स्थान, अम्,
n. the firmness or freshness of youth.
—वयः-
स्थापन, अस्, ई, अम्, maintaining or preserving the
freshness of youth.
—वयस्-कर, अस्, आ or ई, अम्,
causing life or health; of mature age (?) .
—वयस्-
कृत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. causing strength, preserving health
or youth; giving life, (Sāy. आयुष्य-प्रद.)
—व-
यस्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. possessed of power or
vigour, mighty, vigorous; possessing or supplying
food, (Sāy. = अन्न-युक्त.)
—वयो-गत, अस्, आ, अम्,
arrived at age, come of age, advanced in years, old,
aged; (अम्), n. the departure of youth; वयो-गते,
when youth is past.
—वयो-जू, ऊस्, ऊस्, उ, Ved. ex-
citing or increasing strength.
—वयो-ऽतिग or वयो-
ऽतीत, अस्, आ, अम्, advanced in age, exceedingly old
or decrepit; passing beyond or liberated from all
periods or stages of existence.
—वयो-धस्, आस्, आस्,
[]
अस्, Ved. = वयो-धा below.
—वयो-धा, आस्, आस्,
अम् (acc. -धाम्, voc. -धस्, nom. pl. m. f. -धास्,
borrowing some of its cases fr. वयो-धस् above),
Ved. giving strength, bestowing or granting health;
possessing strength, powerful, mighty, vigorous,
youthful, young, middle-aged; giving food, (Sāy.
= अन्नस्य दातृ); (आस्), f. strength, power, might,
vigour.
—वयो-ऽधिक, अस्, आ, अम्, superior in years,
older in age; very old or advanced in age, exceed-
ingly old; (अस्), m. an old man.
—वयो-धेय, अम्,
n., Ved. power, energy, vigour.
—वयो-नाध, अस्,
आ, अम् (नाध fr. rt. नह्), Ved. (perhaps) esta-
blishing health.
—वयो-वयः-शय, अस्, आ, अम्,
Ved. resting on all kinds of food or where food of
every kind rests.
—वयो-ऽवस्था, f. a stage or state
of life (generally considered to be three, viz. बाल-
त्व, childhood, तरुण-त्व, youth, and वृद्ध-
त्व, old age).
—वयो-विध, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. of
the kind or nature of birds.
—वयो-वृद्ध, अस्, आ,
अम्, advanced in years, old.
—वयो-वृध्, त्, त्, त्,
Ved. increasing strength or energy, strengthening,
invigorating (said of the Maruts and of Morning and
Night); increasing food, (Sāy. = अन्नस्य वर्ध-
यितृ.)
—वयो-हानि, इस्, f. loss of youth or vigour,
the growing old.

वयस, अस्, m., Ved. = वयस्, a bird; (अम्), n.
age, (at the end of a comp., e. g. मध्यम-वय-
सम्, middle age; cf. उत्तर-व्˚, पूर्व-व्˚.)

वायस वायस, अस्, m. (probably fr. वयस्,
‘age,’ but according to Uṇādi-s. III. 120. fr. rt. वय्),
‘the long-lived one,’ a crow; Agallochum or fragrant
aloe (= अगुरु); turpentine; (अस्, ई, अम्), used by
crows (?); consisting of birds; (ई), f. a female crow;
a species of fig, Ficus Oppositifolia; a particular
vegetable, Solanum Indicum.
—वायसादनी (˚स-
अद्˚), f. a kind of plant or tree (= काक-तुण्डी).
—वायसारि (˚स-अरि˚), इस्, m. or वायसाराति (˚स-
अर्˚), इस्, m. ‘crow's enemy,’ an owl.
—वायसाह्वा
(˚स-आह्˚), f. an esculent vegetable, Solanum Indicum
(= काक-माचिका).
—वायसेक्षु (˚स-इक्˚), उस्, m.
a sort of long grass, Saccharum Spontaneum.

वयसिन्, ई, इनी, इ, being in any age or period of
life, (at the end of comps., see पूर्व-व्˚, प्रथ-
म-व्˚.)

वयस्क = वयस्, age, (at the end of an adj. comp.,
e. g. अभिनव-वयस्का, a woman in the fresh bloom
of youth.)

वयस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to age, being of
the same age, contemporary; (अस्), m. a contempo-
rary, associate, companion, friend; (आ), f. a female
companion or friend, a woman's confidante or faith-
ful female servant; scil. इष्टका, Ved. epithet of
nineteen bricks used for building the sacrificial altar
(so called from the word वयस् being contained in
the formula of consecration).
—वयस्य-त्व, अम्,
n. or वयस्य-भाव, अस्, m. the condition of being
a contemporary, companionship, friendship.
वयस्यक, अस्, m. a contemporary, friend.

वयाक, अस्, m. a little branch, tendril, creeper
(= लता).

वायक, अस्, m. a weaver [cf. पट्टिका-व्˚]; a
heap, multitude, number.

वयाकिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. having little branches or
tendrils, ramifying (said of the Soma plant).

1. वयुन, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (perhaps) having vital
power, endowed with life (in Śata-patha-Brāhmaṇa
VIII. 2, 2, 8).

वयुन 2. वयुन, अम्, n. (according to
Uṇādi-s. III. 61. fr. rt. वी, substituted for rt. अज्), a
mark, token, sign, characteristic (Ved.); a rule,
ordinance, sacred rite, appointment, order; manner,
custom, mode of acting, actions; distinctness, clear-
ness, (in the preceding senses generally Ved. and
frequently आनि, n. pl.); the faculty of perceiving,
consciousness, knowledge, wisdom, information, in-
struction, (Sāy. = प्रज्ञा, प्रज्ञान, ज्ञान-सा-
धन, ज्ञान); a temple; (अस्), m., N. of a son
of Kṛśāśva and Dhiṣaṇā; (आ), f. knowledge; N.
of a daughter of Svadhā.
—वयुन-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
Ved. wisdom-bestowing, endowed with wisdom or
sense, (Sāy. = प्रज्ञोपेत); clear, distinct, bright,
(Sāy. on Ṛg-veda VI. 21, 3 = प्रकाश-वत्.)
—व-
युन-शस्, ind., Ved. according to rule or order, in
due order, in the order of knowledge, (Sāy. = ज्ञान-
क्रमेण.)
—वयुना-विद्, त्, त्, त् (in the Pada-pāṭha
[]
text वयुन-विद्), Ved. learned in rules, well versed
in ordinances.
वयोवङ्ग वयोवङ्ग (?) , अम्, n. lead.
वायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, weaving, sewing.

वायत वायत, अस्, m. (fr. वयत्), Ved. ‘son
of Vayat,’ a patronymic of Pāśa-dyumna.
वायव वायव. See col. 2.

वायव, अस्, ई, अम्, windy, relating or belonging
to the wind or to Vāyu; given by Vāyu; aerial; (ई),
f. the quarter or region of the wind, the north-west
(as presided over by Vāyu in his character of the
sixth Loka-pāla).

वायसोली or वायसोलिका, f. a medicinal root (=
काकोली).

वायु वायु, उस्, m. (fr. rt. 2. वा), air, wind,
the god of the wind (often associated with Indra in the
Ṛg-veda, but not occupying a very prominent posi-
tion; in the Puruṣa-sūkta he is said to have sprung
from the breath of Puruṣa, and elsewhere is described
as the son-in-law of Tvaṣṭṛ; he is said to move in
a shining car drawn by a pair of red or purple horses
or by several teams consisting of ninety-nine or a
hundred or even a thousand horses; he is often
made to occupy the same chariot with Indra, and in
conjunction with him honoured with the first draught
of the Soma libation; he is rarely connected with
the Maruts, although in 1. 134, 4. he is said to have
begotten them from the rivers of heaven; he is
regent of the north-west quarter, see लोक-पाल);
the air of the body, a vital air (of which five are
reckoned, viz. प्राण, अपान, समान, उदान,
and व्यान); morbid affection of the windy humor.
—वायु-केतु, उस्, m. ‘wind-sign,’ i. e. ‘sign of wind,’
dust.
—वायु-केश, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. having hair
(waving) in the wind (said of the Gandharvas).
—वायु-कोण, अस्, m. ‘wind-corner,’ the north-west.
—वायु-गण्ड, अस्, m. ‘wind-swelling,’ flatulence,
indigestion.
—वायु-गति, इस्, इस्, इ, going like the
wind, swift as the wind, fleet.
—वायु-गीत, अस्, आ,
अम्, chanted by the breeze.
—वायु-गुल्म, अस्, m.
‘wind-cluster,’ a whirlwind, hurricane; a whirlpool,
eddy.
—वायु-गोचर, अस्, m. the track or range of
the wind.
—वायु-गोपा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. having
the Wind as protector.
—वायु-ग्रस्त, अस्, आ, अम्,
‘wind-seized,’ affected by wind, flatulent, epileptic,
mad.
—वायु-घ्न, अस्, ई, अम्, ‘wind-destroying,’
curing windy disorders.
—वायु-ज, ‘air-born,’ N.
of a tree.
—वायु-जात, अस्, m. ‘wind-born,’ epithet
of Hanu-mat.
—वायु-तनय or वायु-नन्दन,
अस्, m. = वायु-पुत्र.
—वायु-दारु, उस्, m. ‘air-
tearer, air-scatterer,’ a cloud.
—वायु-नाना-त्व, अम्,
n. diversity or multiplicity of air (said to be inferred
from the concurrence [सम्मूर्छन] of two winds).
—वायु-निघ्न, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘subject to wind,’ mad,
frantic.
—वायु-निवृत्ति, इस्, f. ‘cessation of wind,’
a calm, lull; cure of windy disorders.
—वायु-पञ्-
चक, अम्, n. the set of five vital airs.
—वायु-प-
[]
रमाणु, उस्, m. a primary aerial atom.
—वायु-
पुत्र, अस्, m. ‘son of the wind,’ epithet of
Bhīma; of Hanu-mat.
—वायु-पुराण, अम्, n.,
N. of one of the eighteen Purāṇas, (it is probably
one of the oldest, and is supposed to have been
revealed by the god Vāyu; it treats of the creation
of the world, the origin of the four classes, the
worship of Śiva, &c.)
—वायु-फल, अम्, n. ‘wind-
fruit,’ the rainbow; hail.
—वायु-भक्ष, अस्, आ,
अम्, air-eating, fasting; (अस्), m. a snake; an ascetic.
—वायु-भक्षण, अम्, n. the act of eating or
living on air, fasting.
—वायु-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, be-
come air, become like the wind; going everywhere
at will.
—वायु-मार्ग, अस्, m. the path or track of
the wind.
—वायु-रुग्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, broken off by
the wind.
—वायु-रोषा, f. ‘raging with wind,’
night.
—वायु-लक्षण, अम्, n. the character or
property of air (viz. touch).
—वायु-वर्त्मन्, आ, m.
‘wind-path,’ the atmosphere, sky, heaven.
—वायु-
वाह, अस्, m. ‘having the wind for a vehicle,’ smoke,
vapour.
—वायु-वाहिनी, f. ‘wind-conveying,’ a vessel
of the body, artery, vein, nerve, &c. (supposed to con-
vey the aerial humor).
—वायु-वेग, अस्, m. the ve-
locity of the wind, a gust or blast of wind; (अस्, आ, अम्),
having the velocity of wind, fleet as the wind; (अस्),
m., N. of a son of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra.
—वायुवेग-सम,
अस्, आ, अम्, equal to the velocity of wind, swift as
the wind.
—वायु-संहिता, f. the ‘Vāyu compen-
dium’ or collection of legends according to the Vāyu-
Purāṇa.
—वायु-सख, अस्, or वायु-सखि, खा, m.
‘wind-friend, having the wind for a friend,’ fire.
—वायु-सम, अस्, आ, अम्, equal to the wind, swift;
like air or wind, unsubstantial.
—वायु-सम्भव,
अस्, m. ‘wind-born,’ epithet of Hanu-mat.
—वायु-
सुत, अस्, m. = वायु-पुत्र above.
—वायु-हीन,
अस्, आ, अम्, destitute of wind, having a deficiency of
the windy humor.
—वायु-अग्नि, ई, m. du. Vāyu
and Agni, the gods of wind and fire.
—वायु-आस्पद,
अम्, n. ‘place or site of the wind,’ the atmosphere,
sky, ether.

वायवीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to the wind or
Vāyu, belonging to air or wind, aerial.
—वायवीय-
पुराण, अम्, n., N. of a Purāṇa.

वायव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to the wind, coming
from or relating to Vāyu, sacred to Vāyu, aerial.
—वायव्य-पुराण, अम्, n., N. of a Purāṇa.

वायु-स्कन्ध, अस्, m. one of the regions of the
wind.
